from datetime import datetime

eur_to_usd = 1.12

transactions_data = """T1002 | 2024-01-16 | West | Acme | 2,098.62 USD | paid
T1005 | 2024-01-17 | South | Birch | 3,921.63 EUR | paid
T1016 | 2024-02-06 | North | Garnet | 4,702.09 EUR | paid
T1020 | 2024-02-08 | South | Fjord | 1,863.02 EUR | pending
T1025 | 2024-02-08 | East | Acme | 3,065.39 USD | paid
T1027 | 2024-02-20 | North | Cobalt | 2,154.01 USD | paid
T1024 | 2024-02-23 | West | Acme | 2,508.19 EUR | pending
T1007 | 2024-02-26 | East | Fjord | 3,392.79 EUR | paid
T1022 | 2024-02-27 | South | Delta | 4,693.58 USD | paid
T1000 | 2024-02-29 | East | Garnet | 3,124.74 EUR | paid
T1018 | 2024-03-07 | West | Fjord | 2,759.49 EUR | paid
T1017 | 2024-03-19 | West | Delta | 1,861.20 USD | refunded
T1008 | 2024-03-25 | West | Garnet | 4,444.63 EUR | paid
T1013 | 2024-03-25 | East | Cobalt | 1,244.56 USD | refunded
T1019 | 2024-04-09 | South | Birch | 2,945.78 USD | paid
T1010 | 2024-04-15 | South | Garnet | 2,711.73 EUR | paid
T1026 | 2024-04-29 | East | Fjord | 4,691.09 EUR | pending
T1011 | 2024-04-30 | North | Birch | 508.72 EUR | paid
T1021 | 2024-05-01 | South | Cobalt | 1,254.99 USD | paid
T1028 | 2024-05-06 | East | Ember | 2,326.36 USD | paid
T1012 | 2024-05-07 | West | Fjord | 3,031.58 USD | paid
T1003 | 2024-05-13 | East | Fjord | 2,622.99 USD | paid
T1004 | 2024-05-13 | South | Garnet | 294.57 USD | refunded
T1014 | 2024-05-23 | North | Acme | 1,500.89 USD | refunded
T1001 | 2024-05-25 | East | Ember | 444.25 USD | paid
T1009 | 2024-05-25 | East | Garnet | 570.85 USD | paid
T1015 | 2024-05-25 | East | Ember | 4,389.91 EUR | paid
T1006 | 2024-06-01 | East | Delta | 4,663.05 EUR | paid
T1023 | 2024-06-06 | West | Fjord | 2,098.36 USD | paid"""

start_date = datetime.strptime("2024-01-26", "%Y-%m-%d")
end_date = datetime.strptime("2024-03-10", "%Y-%m-%d")

# Alternative method: build list of transactions then aggregate
valid_transactions = []

for line in transactions_data.strip().split('\n'):
    cols = [c.strip() for c in line.split('|')]
    tid, date_str, region, customer, amount_currency, status = cols
    
    trans_date = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
    
    # Filter: within date range and not pending
    if start_date <= trans_date <= end_date and status != "pending":
        # Parse amount and currency
        amt_parts = amount_currency.split()
        amount = float(amt_parts[0])
        currency = amt_parts[1]
        
        # Convert to USD
        if currency == "EUR":
            amount = amount * eur_to_usd
        
        # Apply sign based on status
        if status == "refunded":
            amount = -amount
        
        valid_transactions.append((customer, amount))

# Aggregate by customer
customer_totals = {}
for customer, amount in valid_transactions:
    customer_totals[customer] = customer_totals.get(customer, 0) + amount

# Find customer with highest net (using sorted, not max)
highest_customer = sorted(customer_totals.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[0][0]

print(f"ANSWER: {highest_customer}")
